posts.title: Cool Website: amionline.net
posts.description: Often I find myself asking, "is this website taking a long time to load, is something wrong with my browser, or has my internet connection dropped again?", and amionline.net helps narrow that down. posts.title: Using Git to Keep Obsidian Notes Synced
posts.description: Why Obsidian? I've recently switched from using the OS included notes apps on my various devices to Obsidian . I really like Markdown for taking notes, it has enough formatting power for what I generally need, and the syntax is simple and intuitive enough that I don't need to constantly interrupt my train of thought to look up how to do something. posts.title: Cool Website: DistroWatch
posts.description: DistroWatch publishes news about and reviews of all sorts of Linux and BSD distros. They have both editor and user reviews of all manner distros, mainstream and obscure. They also have a search feature which lets you filter by certain traits (size, init system, supporting particular hardware architectures, etc.).
